 Dengue claims eight more lives
 Published : 15 November 2026
 • 
 Updated : 15 November 2026, 03:14
 • 
 HEALTHCARE
 SHARE 
 Staff Correspondent 
 At least eight more people died of dengue and 1,674 were hospitalised across the country in the 24 hours till 8:00am yesterday, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 Of the latest fatalities, six were reported in Dhaka division and one each in Chattogram and Rajshahi divisions.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the latest deaths, the country’s dengue toll has risen to 491, while the cumulative number of cases has reached 1,60,557.
 Currently, 5,915 dengue patients are receiving treatment at hospitals nationwide.
